_readme: Decisions that a language keeps in English on purpose. The i18n check fails on any string the page renders that is still English while another language translates it, unless it is written down here with its reason. A decision that no longer applies is a failure too — an allowlist that only grows is a place to hide.

th.credentialsSect.stackTag: A loanword. This is the tag on the reference-standards plate. ko and ja transliterate it, zh translates it; Thai engineering keeps the English word, and the label is the only place it appears.
th.brandSect.kicker: The name of the product, not a description of it. The Thai section says 'Brand Kit' in all four of its strings — the fold line, the kicker, the download button and the expand link — so translating one of them would break the section.
th.cx.leap.v1: The project's name. ko transliterates it (오빗럴); the other languages keep the name as it is written.
th.panels.p09.cta: A version marker and a protocol name.
th.panels.ikigai.name: The system's name.
th.teamContent.pb2for: The title of a published handbook.
th.credentialsSect.t2i5: The name of a standards framework.
